description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting session tracking documents. It includes functions for normalizing session data, handling pagination, filtering, and caching of list responses.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts Decimal128 or string values to plain JavaScript numbers, returning NaN if parsing fails.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDoc
methods.description: Normalizes session document fields to ensure numeric values are properly parsed and defaulted.
